WITH d AS (
  SELECT r.calif, julianday(v.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(v.order_estimated_delivery_date) AS dias
  FROM vw_entregas_retrasos v
  JOIN (SELECT order_id, AVG(review_score) AS calif FROM order_reviews GROUP BY order_id) r ON r.order_id = v.order_id
  WHERE v.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
),
rango AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN dias <= 0 THEN 'a tiempo'
      WHEN dias <= 3 THEN '1-3'
      WHEN dias <= 7 THEN '4-7'
      WHEN dias <= 14 THEN '8-14'
      ELSE '15+'
    END AS rango,
    COUNT(*) AS pedidos,
    AVG(calif) AS calif_promedio,
    SUM(CASE WHEN calif <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pedidos_2_o_menos
  FROM d
  GROUP BY rango
)
SELECT 
  rango,
  pedidos,
  ROUND(100.0 * pedidos_2_o_menos / pedidos, 2) AS pct_2_o_menos,
  ROUND(100.0 * pedidos_2_o_menos / (SELECT pedidos FROM rango WHERE rango = 'a tiempo'), 2) AS pct_2_o_menos_vs_atraso
FROM rango
WHERE pct_2_o_menos >= 2 * (SELECT pedidos_2_o_menos FROM rango WHERE rango = 'a tiempo')
ORDER BY rango

WITH vendedores AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS ingresos, AVG(r.review_score) AS calif, 
         100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(v.order_delivered_customer_date) > julianday(v.order_estimated_delivery_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_tarde
  FROM order_items oi 
  JOIN vw_pedidos_validos v ON v.order_id = oi.order_id 
  LEFT JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = v.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
ranked_vendedores AS (
  SELECT seller_id, ingresos, calif, pct_tarde, 
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ingresos DESC) AS ingresos_rank,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY calif) AS calif_rank,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pct_tarde) AS pct_tarde_rank
  FROM vendedores
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS vendedores_con_25_pct_mayor_ingreso,
       SUM(ingresos) AS ingresos_totales
FROM ranked_vendedores
WHERE ingresos_rank <= 0.25 AND (calif_rank < 0.5 OR pct_tarde_rank > 0.15)
